@title BatchRouter
 @notice One-click atomic flows built on top of LendingPool using Arc's
         Multicall3From pattern (msg.sender is preserved through CallFrom).
         Arc-native features used:
         - Permit2 allowance transfer (gasless approval before supply or repay).
         - Arc Memo contract (attached to repay leg of "repay+withdraw" flow).
         Flows:
         1. supplyAndBorrow       — supply collateral then borrow in one tx.
         2. repayAndWithdraw      — repay debt then withdraw collateral in one tx.
         3. repayAllAndClose      — repay full debt + withdraw all collateral (close position).
         4. permit2Supply         — Permit2 transferFrom then supply (gasless approval).
         5. permit2Repay          — Permit2 transferFrom then repay (gasless approval + memo).
         Security:
         - BatchRouter never holds funds between calls.
         - All calls are msg.sender-on-behalf-of; the pool enforces per-user accounting.
         - No flash loan surface; no state is written here.
         - Permit2 signature replay is prevented by Permit2's nonce.

@title SteadFiAccessControl
 @notice Lightweight role-based access control for SteadFi.
         Four roles:
         - OWNER: can add/remove markets, transfer roles, set the risk admin.
         - RISK_ADMIN: can update risk parameters (LTV, caps, rate model, oracle).
           On mainnet all RISK_ADMIN calls must come through the Timelock.
         - PAUSE_GUARDIAN: can pause/unpause any market instantly (hot wallet).
         - LIQUIDATION_EXECUTOR: can call liquidate() on the isolated USYC pool
           as the protocol fallback.
         Deliberately NOT using OZ AccessControl to keep the footprint small and
         auditable. All role changes emit events.
@notice Grace period after eta during which the tx can still be executed.

@title DecimalNormalizer
 @notice Converts token amounts between their native decimals and Ray (1e27).
         Arc-specific invariant enforced here:
         - USDC and EURC: 6 decimals (ERC-20 interface only).
         - cirBTC: 8 decimals.
         - WETH: 18 decimals.
         - Native USDC (18 dec) is NEVER passed through here; all protocol
           accounting uses the ERC-20 6-decimal interface exclusively.
         Rounding direction is caller-supplied:
         - roundUp = true  → debt paths (borrower owes the dust)
         - roundUp = false → supply paths (protocol keeps the dust)

@title RayMath
 @notice Fixed-point arithmetic at 27-decimal Ray precision (1e27).
         All SteadFi internal accounting uses Ray. Token amounts are scaled to
         Ray on entry and unscaled on exit. Rounding direction:
         - mulRayDown / divRayDown: truncate (rounds toward zero) — used for supply shares
           (protocol keeps the dust).
         - mulRayUp / divRayUp: round up — used for debt shares (borrower owes the dust).

@title sToken
 @notice ERC-20 supply receipt token. Each sToken represents a share of the
         corresponding asset supply in the LendingPool.
         Rebasing via supply index:
           underlying balance = shares * supplyIndex / RAY
         The LendingPool is the only minter/burner. Transfer is allowed so
         sTokens can be held in wallets, but the underlying yield accrues to
         whoever holds the shares.
         Arc note: sToken for USDC uses the ERC-20 USDC address at 6 decimals.
         Never reads native USDC balance (address.balance).
